Named probe scripts and hashed raw sidecars now exist on this tree and re-run to exit 0.

retry.policy: no automatic retry: a failure here is a finding, not a transient; re-run only after a named change to the harness or the fixture

residual_unknowns.claim: r2e_loop still launches vendor CLIs with danger-full-access; whether those CLIs re-evaluate mutated permissions before each of their own tool calls is out of this unit's SUT.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Hook a vendor PreToolUse path through Supervisor.authorize and re-run TST-0228 against a live Codex/Grok tool-call stream.

findings.summary: Production supervisor revoke is visible on the next authorize() call; start-time-only evaluation is distinguished by the negative control.

report.question_or_target: When a capability is revoked while a unit is running, does the next tool call fail rather than the permission being evaluated only at unit start? PASS requires denial within one call of the revocation.
report.answer: YES on the estate production gate tools/lib/capability_gate.py: supervisor revoke is followed by DENY on call_ordinal=2 with calls_after_revocation=1; the child unit observes CapabilityRevokedError; both-states ALLOW; start-time-only mutant ALLOW then exit 1.
